title: ONLINE index build proposed on Standard Edition 2
expected_feedback: Standard: a non-online CREATE INDEX takes a Share lock that blocks every INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on ORDERS for the whole build — minutes on 12M rows. The usual fix, appending ONLINE, is not available here: online index builds require Enterprise Edition and this database is SE2, so recommending it would produce a plan that cannot run. On SE2 the options are a maintenance window with DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT set (already done), or building into an interim table and cutting over. State the edition dependency explicitly in Uncovered Risks — a reviewer who assumes EE will approve an impossible plan.
violated_rule: Edition-gated mitigations must be checked against the actual edition

lint_detail_must_contain.ORA006: Enterprise Edition and this database is SE2
